instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "See who a community's matchmaker proposed for me and where each introduction stands, what my profile still misses, the shortlist my AI still has to score, and fellow members who share my categories", and give it community_id (The community whose matchmaker runs: its settings are the match-community record of this id.); person.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-my-community-matches and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads one member's view (person): on (their switch), cadence_label, next_at, matches (each match_id, status and the community's words for it, answered, answer_by, consent: what to answer a yes with, with, why: the scoring AI's cited reasons, topics, space_id once they are in the one-to-one), profile (answers, categories, complete, missing questions), waiting_for_your_scores (the open round's shortlist with citable claims), discover (members sharing a category, with what they offer and seek), waiting_jobs (this person's own waiting jobs, for their AI to pull: nothing is ever written into another person's account), wake_at (when the community's clock next acts, so the member side wakes then and pulls once), and for the community's owner experiments (each arm's introduced and talked counts and the shown and converted events an experiment owner reads).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: match-community (records:read); match-member (records:read, records:list); match-round (records:read, records:list); match-ask (records:read, records:list); match (records:read, records:list); match-answer (records:read, records:list); ai-job (records:read, records:list); group (records:read).
